name: SettingsDialog
description:
The settings pattern (R13.2): header with icon tile, title and a data subtitle; an L3
rail of sections beside a scrolling pane; a pinned footer. The rail is the shared
VerticalTabs, so it becomes a chip strip (or a picker) when the dialog is narrow — on a
phone sheet, in a small window. Its height is fixed so switching sections never
resizes the dialog.
signature: ({ trigger, open: openProp, onOpenChange, icon, title, subtitle, sections, section, defaultSection, onSectionChange, footer, footerStart, dirty, onDiscard, size, }: SettingsDialogProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: dirty
props.description: Guard closing while there are unsaved changes.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer actions, primary last: Cancel, then an ActionButton "Save changes".

props.name: icon
props.description: An icon element without an explicit size; the component sizes it through its tokens.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: Called when the person confirms discarding unsaved changes, just before the dialog closes; revert the form here.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the next open state when the dialog opens or closes. While `dirty`, a dismissal first asks to discard and only reports false once the person confirms. Pair with `open` to control it.

props.name: onSectionChange
props.description: Write the section to the URL when it is a place (R6.2).

props.name: open
props.description: Controls whether the overlay is open.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Control that opens the overlay or action.
